packet.defect: PAY-3 has the worker hold its lock for a 2-second capture (citing LOCK-2), LOCK-2 limits a lock to 5 ticks, and CFG-1 defines a tick as 100 milliseconds, so the lock lasts 500 ms and expires during the capture.
evidence_quotes: A payment capture takes 2 seconds, and the worker holds its lock for the whole capture (LOCK-2)
A lock is held for at most 5 ticks (see CFG-1 for the tick)
